options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: clockstats
options.description: Enable or disable logging reference clock statistics.

options.name: dnsresolv
options.description: The IP protocol peers are forced to use for DNS resolution.

options.name: enable
options.description: Enables or disabled the NTP server.

options.name: interface
options.description: The interfaces the NTP server will listen on.

options.name: leapsec
options.description: The Leap second configuration as text.

options.name: logpeer
options.description: Enable or disable logging peer messages.

options.name: logsys
options.description: Enable or disable logging system messages.

options.name: loopstats
options.description: Enable or disable logging clock discipline statistics.

options.name: ntpmaxpeers
options.description: The maximum number of candidate peers in the NTP pool.

options.name: ntpmaxpoll
options.description: The maximum poll interval for NTP messages. Use empty string to assume system default, and `omit` to not set this value. This value must be greater than the `ntpminpoll`.

options.name: ntpminpoll
options.description: The minimum poll interval for NTP messages. Use empty string to assume system default, and `omit` to not set this value.

options.name: orphan
options.description: The orphan mode stratum to set. Orphan mode allows the system clock to be used when no other clocks are available. The number here specifies the stratum reported during orphan mode and should normally be set to a number high enough to ensure that any other servers available to clients are preferred over this server

options.name: peerstats
options.description: Enable or disable logging peer statistics.

options.name: serverauth
options.description: Enable or disable NTPv3 server authentication. (RFC 1305)

options.name: serverauthalgo
options.description: The digest algorithm for the server authentication key.

options.name: serverauthkey
options.description: The NTP server authentication key.

options.name: statsgraph
options.description: Enable or disable RRD graphs for NTP statistics.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
